title: Re-resolve linkage when resuming a woken run
narrative: Persistent goals live in the client orchestrator. When a goal wakes, MechaHarness must re-resolve linkage and resume only if the checkpoint fingerprint still matches. Accepts the library half of inspiration requirement 17[^insp-r17]. Wake re-resolve for Dots MH-DOTS-02; effect-dispatch revalidation: `fangore_insp_effect_revalidation`[^insp-dots-02-wake].
implementation: Client wakes call `LinkageResolver` then `GraphExecutor.run(resume=True)`. Fingerprint mismatch fails closed. Goal stores remain outside the library.
validation: Kind `wake_reresolve_resume`. Soft expects re-resolve ok then successful resume with matching fingerprint.
